result: Probe done: libniji's 64 KiB static TLS surplus is 38x the reference's default initial-exec room (65536 vs 1712 bytes, threads first or not); the reference exceeds it only with glibc.rtld.optional_static_tls above 64336; but on libniji the 64 KiB also bounds global-dynamic TLS of dlopened objects (4 of 16 KiB open vs 64 on the reference)
head: d297413e3

gate.affected: 0 passed / 0 failed (0 of 321 targets selected: results/ and handoff/ only; static ok; precheck GREEN 34 checks)

rulings.item: HL-33 size of libniji's static TLS surplus (64 KiB) against the reference (1712 bytes default, N+1200 with glibc.rtld.optional_static_tls=N)
rulings.recommendation: keep 64 KiB; honour glibc.rtld.optional_static_tls raise-only (surplus = max(64 KiB, value)), read cold only when GLIBC_TUNABLES names it, owner's call

rulings.item: the 64 KiB bounds ALL TLS of dlopened objects (D-27.39 puts every model in the surplus; dynamic blocks are plan row DL-19's): 4 x 16 KiB global-dynamic objects open on libniji, 64 (1 MiB) on the reference (flag #7999)
rulings.recommendation: schedule DL-19 dynamic blocks for objects without DF_STATIC_TLS, keeping the surplus for those that need it; meanwhile a known-limitation / differences row

informational: libniji does not read glibc.rtld.optional_static_tls or glibc.rtld.nns (no effect in any row)

a glibc-built program run on libniji needs LD_LIBRARY_PATH for libc.so.6 (RUNPATH never supplies it, COMPAT-37); runs 1 and 2 of the probe measured nothing on libniji for that and a script error, run 3 is valid

impact.what: evidence only: probe table for audit row HL-33 (results/tls-surplus/)
owner rulings on the HL-33 tunable and on DL-19 dynamic blocks (flag #7999)

improvement: the role scripts could offer a 'run a glibc-built program on libniji' helper (PT_INTERP + LD_LIBRARY_PATH on the program only): two of three probe runs here were lost to the env/timeout and RUNPATH traps
next_step: owner rulings on the two items; if the second is accepted, brief DL-19 (dynamic TLS blocks for objects without DF_STATIC_TLS)
